RevCast AI

Probabilistic Revenue Forecasting & Budget Optimization for Paid Media

Live
AI/ML + Full-Stack

Problem Statement

Paid media teams lack reliable tools to forecast revenue with uncertainty bounds, leading to over/under-spending on campaigns.

Solution

Built a Monte Carlo simulation engine that runs thousands of probabilistic scenarios to generate confidence intervals for revenue forecasts, with budget optimization recommendations and AI-generated summaries.

Key Features

  • Monte Carlo simulation with configurable iterations
  • Confidence interval generation (P10, P50, P90)
  • Budget allocation optimization
  • AI-generated forecast summaries
  • Interactive charts and visualizations
  • REST API backend with FastAPI
